sentences.text: The Right to Service (RTS) scheme aims to ensure timely delivery of public services to citizens.
It was introduced to promote transparency and accountability in the functioning of government departments.
The primary objective is to provide a time-bound framework for the delivery of services.
Benefits include reduced waiting times for services and improved efficiency in government operations.
Citizens can access various services such as certificates licenses and permits under this scheme.
Eligibility criteria may vary based on the specific service being requested.
The application process typically involves submitting a request through the designated government portal or office.
The timeline for service delivery is defined for each service and is usually specified in the service charter.
Implementing authorities include state governments and various departments responsible for public service delivery.
The scheme is operational in multiple states across India with variations in implementation.
